name: Winner-Take-All Neural Competition Model
description: Neural network model where competing populations inhibit each other, leading to winner-take-all dynamics. Used in models of attention, decision-making, and working memory. Source: Wang (2002). Neuron. DOI: 10.1016/S0896-6273(02)01092-9

flows.name: Pop1_Dynamics
flows.equation: (-Population_1_Activity + Sigmoid(Input_1 + Self_Excitation * Population_1_Activity - Cross_Inhibition * Population_2_Activity)) / Tau

flows.name: Pop2_Dynamics
flows.equation: (-Population_2_Activity + Sigmoid(Input_2 + Self_Excitation * Population_2_Activity - Cross_Inhibition * Population_1_Activity)) / Tau

reference: Wang, X.J. (2002). Probabilistic decision making by slow reverberation in cortical circuits. Neuron, 36(5), 955-968.
